ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁאֵין מַסְפִּיק אֹכֶל, הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה צְרִיכָה לְקַבֵּל הַחְלָטוֹת קָשׁוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Jacob worries about his family because of hunger and is afraid to send Benjamin to Egypt but must do so to get food.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים הִסְבִּירוּ לְיַעֲקֹב מַדּוּעַ סִפְּרוּ עַל בִּנְיָמִין.
ideas.children_en: Jacob wonders why the brothers told the ruler about Benjamin. They answer it was by accident because they were asked questions.

ideas.children_he: יְהוּדָה הִבְטִיחַ לָקַחַת אַחֲרָיוּת עַל אָחִיו הַקָּטָן.
ideas.children_en: Judah asks to bring Benjamin so the family can live and promises to be responsible and protect him.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב הִסְכִּים לִשְׁלֹחַ אֶת בִּנְיָמִין וְקִוָּה שֶׁיַּחְזֹר בְּשָׁלוֹם.
ideas.children_en: Jacob sends Benjamin with the brothers, takes special gifts, and hopes Joseph will be kind and send Simeon and Benjamin home.
Joseph sees Benjamin and prepares a meal and hospitality for the brothers to honor and host them comfortably.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים פָּחֲדוּ כִּי לֹא הֵבִינוּ מַדּוּעַ הֻזְמְנוּ לַבַּיִת.
ideas.children_en: The brothers fear the man because they think he is angry about the money, so they explain it was a mistake.

ideas.children_he: דִּבְרֵי הַרְגָּעָה יְכוֹלִים לַעֲזֹר כְּשֶׁמִּישֶׁהוּ מְפַחֵד.
ideas.children_en: Joseph’s steward comforts the brothers, says he has the money, planned everything, gives them water and food as guests.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף הִתְרַגֵּשׁ מְאֹד כְּשֶׁרָאָה אֶת בִּנְיָמִין.
ideas.children_en: The brothers bow to Joseph, he shows love to Benjamin, asks for mercy, then cries alone in his room.

ideas.children_he: לִפְעָמִים רֶגֶשׁ חָזָק גּוֹרֵם לָנוּ לִבְכּוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Joseph hides his tears, gets ready, and tells his servants to serve food to the brothers and guests.

ideas.children_he: הָאֲרוּחָה הִתְנַהֲלָה לְפִי הַמִּנְהָגִים שֶׁל הָאֲנָשִׁים בְּמִצְרַיִם.
ideas.children_en: Each guest had a separate table, and the brothers notice Joseph eats apart because of religious differences.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים הִתְפַּלְּאוּ כְּשֶׁהוֹשִׁיבוּ אוֹתָם לְפִי גִּילָם.
ideas.children_en: Joseph seated the brothers by age, which surprised them because it was hard to know who was older when grown up.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף נָתַן לְבִנְיָמִין מָנָה גְּדוֹלָה יוֹתֵר, וְהָאַחִים יָשְׁבוּ יַחַד.
ideas.children_en: Joseph gave gifts to all brothers, but gave Benjamin a bigger gift. Then they drank and enjoyed together.
